name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: GDACS lists only a green-level alert for Tropical Cyclone Xavier near the Cook Islands on 16 Nov
state: GDACS listed one tropical cyclone alert at 05:40 UTC on 16 Nov, a green-level alert for Tropical Cyclone Xavier near the Cook Islands, and no orange or red alerts (GDACS). No typhoon or cyclone threatening a populated coast within 72 hours was flagged.
for_you: No major Pacific or Indian Ocean storm is threatening land; travellers to the South Pacific can follow local meteorological services.
why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
